crash_scope.actual_tests: Owned-process SIGKILL before SQLite commit and after commit before response at both G/E; closed accepted-prefix recovery and exact retry. Separate capture-publication fault injection and initialized-schema guard checks.
crash_scope.limit: The OS remains alive. These tests establish no physical power-loss, controller-cache, malicious-filesystem or Byzantine-storage guarantee and do not by themselves explain old anomalies.
crash_scope.serialization: A shared per-service OS file lock plus reentrant thread lock spans cooperating real store writes, capture/preflight and inherited constructors. No timing-delay guard is substituted for exclusion.

bridge.cross_layer_direction: Test the direction; do not assume lower raw correction means lower proof waste. Pre-proof rejection suppresses proof starts. Fewer rejected proposals can increase valid-proof arrivals, queueing and stale-prefix waste at fixed offered load. A policy may improve delivery, worsen unused work, do both or do neither; all outcomes remain reportable.

evidence_and_load_comparators.claims: Raw paired work/latency distributions and reference-world-block intervals are descriptive engineering/system characterizations. Proof versus attestation speed never establishes equivalent assurance or deployment security.
evidence_and_load_comparators.count_derivation: Eight matrix treatments × three loads × two pools × ten independently seeded reference-world blocks. At256 offers,122,880 total offers and at most61,440 proof calls.
evidence_and_load_comparators.fixed_group_component_replay: Before any batch-speed attribution, close a genuine reference-generated valid proof/request corpus with source/key/public/private bindings; replay exactly identical frozen group partitions through both actual strict individual and randomized G/E backends. Include groups1,2,4,8,16 where the corpus supports them, multiple independent reference-world corpora and fresh randomized coefficients per replay. Treat within-corpus repeats as nested measurements. This isolates verification work; it is not a new learned-policy or closed-loop useful-task comparison.
evidence_and_load_comparators.grouping: Exogenous offered arrivals and independent concurrent builder requests/provers; freeze the same group_max/wait RULE for strict individual and randomized live conditions, with the same key precomputation, decoding/subgroup rules and G/E separation. Realized groups may differ because service timing changes future queues/world snapshots; record every group/cardinality and do not call them identical. A no-uptake cell supports no batching-benefit inference.

matrix.gateway_trust: Groth16 soundness, bound commitments, authentic setup/key/genesis; E still trusts faithful native application.
Same as proof plus the declared randomized verification error model; independent fresh nonzero128-bit challenges at G/E. No proof aggregation.
Gateway observes the disclosed relation state/actions/openings and recomputes the predicate; authentic operator and commitments remain trusted.
Gateway trusts the registered attestor predicate evaluation. Same external commit contract is not assurance equivalence. No TEE claim.

inference.failure_policy: No outcome-based case replacement, load/phase/candidate selection, checkpoint selection, exclusion of zero work or claims of equivalence from nonsignificance.
inference.intervals: Report paired-cluster95% bootstrap intervals with10,000 resamples and a separately fixed RNG; paired-t intervals as a descriptive sensitivity, and dz only when paired SD>0. Intervals are not simultaneous familywise intervals unless explicitly constructed as such.
inference.multiplicity: One prespecified global Holm12 family: six learning contrasts (three within each domain) plus these six execution contrasts. Partial-family results are descriptive until all12 close. Original historical M2 multiplicity family is unchanged.
inference.test: Two-sided paired whole-cluster exact sign-flip test under the stated sign-symmetry/exchangeability null; report mean paired differences, all cluster values, exact p and global adjustment.
inference.unit: Independent training-initialization cluster for learned execution:20 clusters. Worlds, offers, agents, phases and two selected policies are nested repeated measures, not independent replications.

policy_population.closure: Complete prescribed training cohort, source/checkpoint/config/export closure and independent NumPy/authoritative sampler agreement before any bridge holdout world. Exact rule_shift profile gate, no old H32 key reuse.
policy_population.matching: The two configurations and four families in a training cluster share the same bank, task streams, phase weights, offered times, proposal-uniform namespaces and compute allocation. Methods retain their own correct learned sampling rule.
policy_population.selection: Use the original development-only primary frontier pair for each family, including any lambda-zero identity cell; the separate nonzero-lambda estimator-ablation pair is not substituted.
policy_population.training: All20 independent warehouse confirmation initialization clusters62001..62020, two development-selected configurations per family, four families:160 final models. No policy/checkpoint is chosen using bridge outcomes.
policy_population.transfer_limit: The controlled proof study addresses custom N4 only. N8/N12 and native RWARE learning results are not silently claimed to have verified-execution evidence.

primary_controlled_execution.accounting: At the fixed complete-drain boundary: invoked proof calls = valid proofs generated + failed/cancelled-before-valid calls + still-inflight calls; valid generated proofs = durably applied proof attempts + valid unapplied proofs. No replans/re-proving in this primary cohort. Report pending categories and exact identities rather than making invalid prefilter rejects into wasted proofs.
primary_controlled_execution.count_derivation: 160 closed final models × two load regimes × two independent paired reference-bank/arrival replicates;256 offers each implies163,840 offers before any runtime admission revision.
primary_controlled_execution.drain: Freeze a bounded complete-drain deadline from engineering before outcomes. Preserve pending/error/cancelled counts and arrival-to-terminal times; incomplete runs are incomplete, not successful partial cohorts.
primary_controlled_execution.family_endpoint: Within one training-seed cluster and load, average the two paired bank/arrival replicates for each fixed selected policy, then compute the two-policy finite frontier hypervolume. Full mathematical rectangle cost[0,1],utility[0,1], reference(cost1,utility0); all unrounded raw points retained. This is a useful-work/unused-proof endpoint, not a compliance threshold.
mandatory_denominators: proof calls / durable applications (NA if zero)
unused valid proofs / all offered requests
useful delivered task units / all offered requests
every raw count and per-phase exposure

per_model_raw_point.cost: Number of valid generated proofs not durably applied by the declared complete drain deadline, divided by all offered requests.
per_model_raw_point.utility: Delivered task units divided by n_agents × all offered requests. Report total deliveries, retained prefix lengths and elapsed/offered time alongside this normalization.

proof_status_ledger: valid proof generated but unapplied at complete drain
primary_controlled_execution.rate_definition: Freeze absolute offers/second from reference-only measured initialized-service capacity with the same profile, proof backend and pool; the measured baseline is not a scientific trained policy. Report absolute rates and capacity uncertainty. Do not recalibrate rates per policy or after outcomes.
task_and_latency: all offered counts and completed task units
admissions and durable applications by phase
queue depth and backlog over time
elapsed and useful task work per wall second
primary_controlled_execution.timer_rule: Subtract union of nested same-thread spans, never sum overlapping parents/threads as wall time. Call the residual unisolated unless further measured. Record service/model/key startup separately from initialized-service per-transition work.
primary_controlled_execution.treatment: Raw institutional reject before proof; genuine proof and optimized strict individual verification at separate G/E consumers; no replan or retry-selection advantage in the performance cohort.
primary_controlled_execution.zero_work: Zero-delivery cases remain in the cohort with utility0 and all raw counts. Proofs/delivery and time/delivery are undefined and reported NA when deliveries0; never assign a favorable zero ratio or remove the case.

bridge.question: Does a learning intervention change useful admitted task work and unused valid-proof work under the same external execution contract?

reference_only_qualification.admission: The proposed256-offer shape is not final. Freeze offers/domains, common bank, load rates, phase coverage, complete-run wall/disk projection and useful-work denominators only after reference-only engineering review. Do not shorten/select the workload using scientific policy outcomes or claim this proposal already demonstrates productive execution.
reference_only_qualification.bank: Fresh reference trajectories generate source-bound complete native snapshots at steps0,64,128,192. Four domains cover these phases with equal weights. The same qualified bank is supplied to every compared policy/evidence treatment in a paired block.
reference_only_qualification.controller: Freeze the native BFS-distance-progress reference minus wall1/occupied-target.5,1e-4 tie noise and10% uniform exploration under declared fixed seeds, plus actual native monitor/application. Retain every raw action, replacement, task transition and source hash. No learned M3 policy enters reference-bank construction.
reference_only_qualification.implementation_gate: The current load driver supports actual fresh-world/seeded multi-prover runs. A source-bound reference state-bank loader and complete scientific cohort runner must be implemented and qualified before this controlled study is launched.
reference_only_qualification.load_gate: Run the actual disclosure/native-admission path with the intended state bank and offered schedule; demonstrate phase-specific checks, pre-proof rejects/repairs, positive useful applications and task work under each proposed load. Use genuine proof engineering to calibrate service capacity and grouping. Preserve all failures.
reference_only_qualification.nonvacuity: Every intended phase must have valid native/scalar states and positive task deliveries in the productive reference workload; retain institutional raw violations/replacements and valid proposals. The intended pressure workload must actually expose institutional corrections. Zero-correction or zero-work conditions cannot establish the missing learning-to-execution link.
reference_only_qualification.timing: Before new scientific policies or bridge holdout worlds are opened. Engineering reference observations never tune Direct or choose confirmatory policies.

relation.assurance_scope: Fresh laboratory single-operator phase2; trusted registered genesis and complete-world simulator/executor. The proof certifies the admitted institutional successor, not neural inference or physical-world truth.
relation.domain: Exact successor-bound custom warehouse rule_shift only; native RWARE requires a separate circuit and qualification.

bridge.resource_accounting: Collect producer/verifier/service process CPU user+system deltas separately from qualified GPU device/kernel times and end-to-end wall time. Node worker elapsed spans are service intervals, not automatically CPU time. Concurrent CPU/GPU/adapter intervals overlap, so wall time is not their sum. This bridge currently executes genuine CPU snarkjs proofs; GPU proof work remains unmeasured until a new-profile GPU backend is separately admitted.
bridge.resource_and_launch_gate: Produce per-stage actual throughput/variance, offered-arrival minimum wall time, expected worst-case proof calls, memory/disk and complete storage/host/device source locks before launching. The large proposed grid may take days on CPU. Learning on CUDA does not make this CPU snarkjs bridge GPU execution; a GPU prover for these new exact keys needs its own independent admission.

rng_and_source_lock.constraint: Before launch enumerate actual seed sets and reject collisions across training, evaluation, reference qualification and confirmation domains. Bind all source files, bank snapshots/replay, actor samplers, native profile, circuit/keys, exact cases, compute/storage identities and analysis recipe.
rng_and_source_lock.mapping: base +100000*training_cluster_index +10000*bank_arrival_replicate +1000*load_index; native source-world phase adds0..3, proposal draw adds offered_index0..255. No replans in scientific performance cohort. Family/configuration omission is intentional common random numbers.

common_controls: same within-domain actor feature and observation access
two separately fitted critics in every arm
same native transition/task and institution cost
complete fixed budgets and final-checkpoint rule

confirmation.checkpoint_rule: Final prescribed step only; retained learning curves do not select test checkpoints.
confirmation.direction: Report two-sided tests, raw differences, intervals and every seed. A nonsignificant result is not equivalence.
confirmation.inference: Paired whole training-seed-cluster exact sign-flip tests within each domain; these six learning contrasts and six controlled-execution contrasts form one global Holm12 family. Cluster bootstrap intervals are descriptive. Until all12 contrasts close, partial-family tests are descriptive and cannot be called a completed familywise result. The historical M2 family is unchanged.
confirmation.power_rationale: Twenty clusters increases resolution and permits uncertainty assessment, but is not a prospective power guarantee; engineering/development variability must inform final lock before these seeds are opened.
confirmation.primary_endpoint: Within each independent training-seed cluster, dominated hypervolume of the two development-selected final policies.

development.budget_status: Requires engineering throughput estimate and root-reviewed lock before scientific launch.
development.profile_exposure: All four profiles are trained; evaluation on new worlds is not unseen-profile generalization.

estimator_ablation.no_novelty_claim: Finite conditional/score gradients are established machinery.
estimator_ablation.same_objective: Same J, beta, lambda and optimizer on fixed states; exact, current-policy score with LOO baseline, and conditional enumeration.

trained_controlled_comparison.configurations: Two NONZERO-lambda Direct configurations jointly maximizing the same development-only two-point hypervolume among the nine nonzero-lambda cells; deterministic candidate-ID tie break. This separately declared mechanism-ablation selection does not alter primary frontier selection. Lambda-zero cells remain identity controls and never count as an active-estimator comparison.
trained_controlled_comparison.inference_scope: Fresh matched training clusters; separate from fixed-state engineering. Exact-minus-score and exact-minus-conditional are a separately declared two-test Holm family. All scheduled cases run even if nonzero auxiliaries fail to improve development frontiers; such a result provides no algorithmic-advantage claim.

No task equivalence/noninferiority inferred from nonsignificance
No submission operation in this protocol

replication.candidate_policy: Two development-selected configurations per family, transferred unchanged unless a separately locked domain-specific tuning study is conducted.
replication.coefficient_size_normalization: lambda_N=lambda_selected_at_N4*4/N preserves explicit joint-risk/per-agent PPO averaging scale. Freeze before replication outcomes; log actual component-gradient ratios because optimization behavior need not be identical.
replication.estimator: Conditional sampling at prequalified K; exact N4 retained as reference only.
replication.independence: These seeds/worlds do not overlap development, confirmation, M2, or reserved historical A2 namespaces.
replication.profiles: Must qualify genuine task feasibility and institutional exposure before scientific outcomes; preserve native RWARE action/physics/rewards and explicit institution wrapper.
replication.rware_profile_gate: A separate source-bound native RWARE profile manifest and reference-only feasibility/exposure receipt is required; custom warehouse profiles are not silently reused.
replication.sampled_work_budget: Proposed N>=8: K2 and16 uniformly sampled auxiliary states per128-group minibatch; sequential shield entropy16 states. All are engineering variance/runtime admission choices, frozen before learning outcomes. N4 estimator learning ablation uses allstates andK32.

selection.cost_rectangle_rationale: Custom .05 brackets prior M2 task-only cost (~.0473); native .10 brackets the reference-only N4 RWARE cost (~.0544). These are ranges of scientific interest, not compliance standards. Both are fixed before any new M3 outcomes and shared by every family within a domain.
selection.identical_objective_cells: Direct lambda=0 cells repeat penalty-only objectives; they are controls, not additional independent replications.
selection.reference_rectangle: Within each domain, cost in [0, declared domain bound], utility in [0,1]; normalize area by that bound. No pooled cross-domain hypervolume claim.
selection.rule: Choose two candidates per family jointly maximizing finite-candidate dominated hypervolume; deterministic candidate_id tie-break.
selection.sensitivity: Retain every raw point, outside-rectangle flags, and descriptive areas for cost limits .01,.025,.05,.1,1; do not select a bound after outcomes.
selection.warning: This is a finite, equally budgeted candidate family, not global optimization or an application-specific noninferiority margin.
